get.summary: List the active acknowledgements of an organization
get.description:
Only acknowledgements whose cycle is still open are listed. A cycle ends on
its own, and once it has, the record is reachable through
`GET /orgs/{org}/alerts/acknowledgements/{acknowledgement_id}` but no longer
appears here.

Because every listed record is active, items carry neither `unackAt` nor
`unackReason`: both are the record of how a cycle ended, and none of these
have.

Minimum role level required to perform this operation: **User**.

post.summary: Acknowledge an alert event
post.description:
An acknowledgement mutes an alert event for `ackDuration`, recording who
acknowledged it and when. An event may have only one active
acknowledgement at a time; once a cycle has ended the same event can be
acknowledged again, and that is stored as a new, distinct record.

`ackBy` is the authenticated user's CCIAM `email` claim, and `ackAt` is set
by the server, so neither is accepted in the payload. Only a JWT carries
that claim, so this endpoint does not accept API-token authentication.

Minimum role level required to perform this operation: **Editor**.

- `null`: no time hint, the UI date picker remains authoritative.

warning.description:
Whether `query` captures the whole search intent. `null` means fully
translated; a sentence means part of the prompt could not be expressed as
a single Quickwit query (a correlation, a temporal sequence, or an
aggregation/sort/count), `query` is then a best-effort translation and the
sentence names what was dropped.

WebhookHeader.description:
A webhook header as stored in the `options` column of `channel_configs`.

When `is_secret` is true, `value` holds the encrypted ciphertext at rest.

WebhookHeaderMasked.description:
A webhook header whose secret value is not transmitted in plaintext.

`value` is `None` exactly when the plaintext must not cross the wire: in
responses it means the value is masked because `is_secret` is true; in
update requests it means "keep the stored value unchanged".

WebhookOptions.description:
The webhook integration options, stored as the JSON `options` column of
`channel_configs`. Written by channel-config, read by generic-webhook when
sending notifications.

WebhookOptionsResponse.description: Response form of [`WebhookOptions`]: secret header values are masked out.

WebhookOptionsUpdate.description:
Partial update of [`WebhookOptions`]: absent fields keep their stored value, and
headers travel masked (see [`WebhookHeaderMasked`]).

alert_events_client_lib.EventId.description:
The identifier of an alert event: the hex-encoded SHA-256 that the alerting
engine derives from the rule and its branch path.

Validated on construction because the id is interpolated into Quickwit
queries: anything but a digest could close the query's org clause and read
another tenant's events.

explorer_traces_query.AggregationRequest.description:
Aggregation parameters for producing time-series curves from trace search
results.

interval.description:
The interval in seconds to use for aggregation. If not specified,
the interval is computed automatically from the time window.
Must be between 1 second and 31_536_000 seconds (1 year).

targetResolution.description:
The number of points on the curves we would like to have.
It is used to compute the interval if not specified.
Must be between 10 and 50_000 (inclusive). Default to 300.
